answer: To open a market seat, an applicant must present three unique shale cores, each assayed and countersigned by a different falcon sponsor drawn from a published atlas roster. Every core hash is bound to the applicant's address and a public work-window, so it cannot be resold or reused. Settlement clusters shared sponsor trios, duplicated core hashes, or matching assay-time skeletons, burns those seats, and benches the overlapping falcon sponsors for two epochs.
